name: Dungeon Reveal
description: Full-screen dungeon map hidden under darkness, revealed through a flickering torch-light circle that follows the cursor or finger, with a slider to resize the lit radius.
contents: Dark overlay with radial light mask
Radius slider panel in the top right
behavior: Light circle follows mouse and touch movement
Radius flickers continuously with a sine wave
Native cursor is hidden and replaced by a torch icon
editableByProps: Slider label and radius range and starting radius
Torch icon color and background color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how soft the light edge is
needsCodeEdit.where: radial-gradient mask classes on the overlay div
svg path inside the cursorRef div

fixed: Fills the full viewport height and hides the native cursor
Touch movement over the overlay is captured with preventDefault, blocking page scroll on touch
